title: PyPI README project tree lists .beads/, planning/VISION.md and `--status todo`, none of which exist
description:
**Problem**
The project-structure example and CLI example in the PyPI long description describe things Kanbus no longer has.

**Evidence**
- python/README.md project tree lists `.beads/` and `planning/VISION.md`.
- It shows `--status todo`, which is not a valid status.

**Fix**
Update the tree to the real layout (`project/issues`, `project/events`, `project/wiki`, `.kanbus.yml`) and use a valid status (e.g. `open`).

**How to verify**
`grep -nE '\.beads|VISION\.md|--status todo' python/README.md` returns nothing, and every command shown in the README runs.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
